review: Inspected current API authorization/persistence, domain completion/version/lifecycle rules, sandbox source, regression assertions and full passed logs, actual fresh-install UI flow and restart observations, latest rendered screens, current server project and all source hashes. 195 existing source/test files equal the fresh-installed verified candidate; new sample code/helper match their actual browser/syntax evidence. API fixture data is not browser execution.
knownLimits: Manual copy/import replaces AI backend; no real ChatGPT invocation.
Local static HTML/CSS/JS sandbox and synthetic demo profiles; no production authentication, backend artifacts, remote team access, or public hosting.
No other OS/cache-empty install/long-term load test.
First built regression failed with worker-restart503; same-server full retry passed, original log retained.
Editable live data supports lifecycle actions; immutable past evidence remains read-only and linked artifacts have removal guards.
Previous demo-* artifacts retain the discovered edit bug for comparison. Use data/demo-safe-edit and safe-edit-preview.html.
New sample state is memory-only and resets on reload; standalone file:// was not tested.
finalFinding: The old sample edit action removed the original row and reset quantity before save. Retained old artifacts and evidence, provided a separately verified safe-edit sample; old basic checks are not treated as proving this boundary.
deliveryIntegrity: Final archive hash and actual re-extraction verification are in verification.json alongside the archive and outputs/latest-submission.json. An archive cannot contain its own final hash; evidence/submission-latest-archive-result.json inside an archive may describe the preceding snapshot. Current workspace copy is refreshed after packing.
